correctness.rationale: Exactly 2640 of 2^21 labelled tournament orientations have outdegree 3 at each of seven vertices. Each has 14 directed cyclic triangles, each legal triangle toggle preserves the score sequence, and the interchange graph therefore has 18480 edges. Independent C++ code scanned all orientations and BFS from all 2640 roots; the graph is connected, has radius 8 and diameter 9, eccentricities 8:1920 and 9:720, each eccentricity-9 tournament has precisely one distance-9 target and that target is its complement. All-pair histogram 1..9 is (18480,120120,447720,970200,1116960,637440,158880,13320,360). The three relabelling orbit profiles in RESULT.md agree exactly with the complete earlier published profiles. The Fano/step-2 parity obstruction for the cyclic tournament separately proves that its converse cannot be reached in seven moves; parity rules out eight. This is finite order-7 only.
